name: Yoiyami no Koibito Vampire Honey
original_name: 宵闇の恋人ヴァンパイアハニー
source:
"I need you so much, I can't stand it..."

The vampire: predator of humans; Satsuki's father was one of those supernatural beings, and has lived his life singled out as a half-vampire.

However, the leader of the vampire clan, Clay has long protected him, and the young leader of the werewolf clan, Shiro, has long yearned for him. To top it off, the vampire hunter Rou is about to make his appearance. 

What will happen...?!

A heartrending tale of love between supernatural beings.
Toying with fate, a story of forbidden love begins!
translation:
“我如此渴望你，简直无法忍耐…”

吸血鬼，是以人类为猎物的存在。萨茨基的父亲便是其中一员，而身为半吸血鬼的他，一直受到排斥。

不过，吸血鬼一族的首领克雷始终保护着他，狼人一族的年轻首领史狼也一直爱慕着他。而吸血鬼猎人罗，也即将登场。

接下来会发生什么…？！

这是一段异类之间令人心痛的爱情故事。
与命运周旋，禁忌的爱情就此展开！
